d: This position reports to the Contact Center Team Leader, accountable to provide the highest standards of customer service through the provision of telephone banking to existing and potential customers.
q: High school diploma or bachelor’s degree or any other equivalent degree.
Relevant certifications in writing or journalism or any other related field.
Minimum of 1 year of experience in call center industry and customer service fields.
Other Skills Required for the Job
Proficient in English & Arabic, both written and spoken.
Familiarity with banking systems, Agent Desktop, call recording software, and email communication.
Ability to remain patient and composed under pressure.
Skilled in using PCs and Microsoft Office applications.
r: a) Receive in-bound calls from customers, prospects and non-customers while maintaining established standards for number of calls, pick-up time, duration of call and quality of call.
b) Provide high quality customer service by answering customer enquiries efficiently and politely with correct and complete information and redirect them where appropriate.
c) Perform customer transactions accurately and in an efficient manner.
d) Perform correct maintenance and set-up for customers.
e) Enhance Revenue by identifying and maximizing selling and cross-selling opportunities.
f) Identify customer problems and offer appropriate solutions.
g) Continuous learning to keep up to date with changes to products, services, and procedures.
h) Participate in Outbound calling programs and other projects and activities when required.
i) Perform any other duties or responsibilities that are consistent with the role as assigned by management.

d: To build the Internal Audit Department as an independent unit with the right resources and processes / tools, to provide reasonable assurance to key stakeholders (Board Audit, Risk, and Compliance Committee (BARC), CEO, Executive Management / Board of Directors (BOD) / senior management / Shareholders) that Company is managing risk effectively and implementing robust governance and internal control measures in line with International Standards. Additionally, the position entails advising relevant stakeholders on best practices to enhance organizational value.
The role also serves as Secretary to BARC, ensuring effective committee governance, coordination, and communication between the Committee, management, and assurance providers.
This role is guided in accordance with the applicable Laws and Regulations, best international practices, as well as both local & international standards.
q: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Excellent report writing and presentation skills.
High level of integrity, objectivity, and professionalism.
Ability to manage multiple audits and meet deadlines.
Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field
Professional certification preferred (CIA, ACCA, CPA, CISA, or equivalent).

Minimum of 7+ years of progressive internal audit experience, preferably within asset management, investment banking, financial services, or a top-tier Big 4 audit firm handling financial services portfolios.
r: Establish and develop the Internal Audit function, including frameworks and methodologies.
Develop and maintain the Internal Audit Charter for Audit Committee approval.
Prepare a risk-based internal audit plan aligned with business priorities.
Lead internal audit engagements across operational, financial, compliance, and IT areas.
Assess the effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls.
Identify key and emerging risks and recommend practical improvements.
Support and enhance the organization’s governance and control environment.
Monitor compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies.
Support regulatory reviews and external audits where required.
Promote best practices in governance and risk management.
Present audit plans, results, and insights to the Audit Committee.
Provide independent views on key risks and control effectiveness.
Escalate significant issues and emerging risks.
Support the Committee in fulfilling its oversight responsibilities.
Serve as Secretary to the Audit Committee, ensuring effective coordination and governance.
Coordinate meeting agendas with the Committee Chair.
Prepare and circulate meeting packs and supporting materials.
Record minutes and track decisions and action items.
Maintain Committee records and annual plans.
Facilitate communication between the Committee, Board, and management.
Ensure alignment with corporate governance requirements.
Deliver clear and timely audit reports.
Monitor implementation of agreed management actions.
Provide regular updates to senior management and the Audit Committee.
Share insights on recurring risks and control themes.
Build and develop the Internal Audit team.
Promote a culture of integrity, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
Ensure adherence to professional standards and ethics.
Encourage innovation and modern audit practices.
Provide advisory support on governance, risk, and controls while maintaining independence.
Stay updated on emerging risks and regulatory developments.
Maintain a Quality Assurance and Improvement Program (QAIP).
Internal: Board Audit, Risk and Compliance Committee, BoD, senior Management, Business Line and other members of the Business/Function.
External: Government Authorities, External Legal Counsels, and specialized consultants.
